The label explicitly locates the operation in preparation or cleaning, not violence or hitting the finished dish. The three anchor groups and shared-verb group have no equally defensible complete repartition; obscurity is not the difficulty mechanism. All applicable recognition, predicate, novelty and B/C/D requirements were reviewed; current101-caption text is part of the dossier. This is an agent judgment, not a measured enjoyment study.
